tldr: Venus through the 12th house brings focus to rest, solitude, endings, hidden patterns, dreams, and spiritual retreat.
body: Venus transiting the 12th house softens rest, solitude, endings, hidden patterns, dreams, and spiritual retreat. For about three to four weeks, ease, attraction, value, pleasure, and relational support move through this part of life, making it harder to ignore what needs attention here. This is a receiving transit: it can bring support, pleasure, repair, and opportunities to value this area with more grace.
business: Venus supports private healing and release: make the call, update the plan, handle the visible task, and let the transit move something practical.
shadow: Avoidance, indulgence, people-pleasing, or escape, isolation, or avoiding what needs care.
advice: Receive and refine in the 12th house deliberately. Work with rest, solitude, endings, hidden patterns, dreams, and spiritual retreat without letting the transit run the whole room.
note: Authored from approved project house-transit material.
